import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/data/nls_bmi_processed.csv')
df.head()

# Filter the data to include only Hispanic men
hispanic_men = df[(df['GENDER'] == 'MALE') & (df['HISPANIC'] == 1)]

# Display the first few rows of the filtered data
hispanic_men.head()

import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Correlation analysis between BMI and DISSAVED, SAMESAVE
correlation_dissaved = hispanic_men['BMI'].corr(hispanic_men['DISSAVED'])
correlation_samesave = hispanic_men['BMI'].corr(hispanic_men['SAMESAVE'])

# Display the correlation coefficients
correlation_dissaved, correlation_samesave

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

# Prepare the data for regression
X_dissaved = hispanic_men[['DISSAVED']].values.reshape(-1, 1)  # Predictor
X_samesave = hispanic_men[['SAMESAVE']].values.reshape(-1, 1)  # Predictor
y = hispanic_men['BMI'].values  # Response

# Regression for DISSAVED
model_dissaved = LinearRegression()
model_dissaved.fit(X_dissaved, y)
coef_dissaved = model_dissaved.coef_[0]

# Regression for SAMESAVE
model_samesave = LinearRegression()
model_samesave.fit(X_samesave, y)
coef_samesave = model_samesave.coef_[0]

coef_dissaved, coef_samesave

from scipy.stats import ttest_ind

# Perform t-test for DISSAVED
mean_bmi_dissaved = hispanic_men[hispanic_men['DISSAVED'] == 1]['BMI'].mean()
mean_bmi_not_dissaved = hispanic_men[hispanic_men['DISSAVED'] == 0]['BMI'].mean()
t_stat_dissaved, p_value_dissaved = ttest_ind(hispanic_men[hispanic_men['DISSAVED'] == 1]['BMI'], hispanic_men[hispanic_men['DISSAVED'] == 0]['BMI'])

# Perform t-test for SAMESAVE
mean_bmi_samesave = hispanic_men[hispanic_men['SAMESAVE'] == 1]['BMI'].mean()
mean_bmi_not_samesave = hispanic_men[hispanic_men['SAMESAVE'] == 0]['BMI'].mean()
t_stat_samesave, p_value_samesave = ttest_ind(hispanic_men[hispanic_men['SAMESAVE'] == 1]['BMI'], hispanic_men[hispanic_men['SAMESAVE'] == 0]['BMI'])

t_stat_dissaved, p_value_dissaved, t_stat_samesave, p_value_samesave
